title: Overdue alerts
summary: Each morning, flags rows past their due date, tells the person assigned and sends the team a list.
description: A daily check over any table with a due date and a status: tasks, jobs, invoices, orders. A row whose due date has passed and isn't done gets an overdue_since stamp, the assigned person gets a notification (when you name an assignee field), and the role you choose gets one notification listing everything overdue. Marking a row done clears the stamp.

params.name: entity
params.label: Table with due dates
params.description: The table of things that can be late (tasks, jobs, invoices).

params.name: due_field
params.label: Due date field
params.description: The date or timestamp field holding when it is due.

params.name: status_field
params.label: Status field
params.description: The enum field that says whether it is finished.

params.name: done_value
params.label: Done value
params.description: The status value that means finished (never overdue).

params.name: assignee_ref
params.label: Assigned person
params.description: Optional: the ref field naming the person responsible, so they are told directly. Leave it out to tell only the team.

params.name: notify_role
params.label: Team to tell
params.description: The role that gets the daily list of overdue rows.

notes: A table with a due date and a status enum.

includes: A daily 09:00 check that stamps and announces overdue rows
A workflow that clears the stamp when a row is done
highlights: One list for the team, not a flood
